name: Pit Bottom
description: The pit floor is damp and cold. Old shells and silt gather here. Something slow and glossy clings to the stone.

skill_check.fail_text: The wall is too slick. You slip back down.

interactables.name: pit floor
interactables.examine_text: Old shells and silt gather here. Something slow and glossy clings to the stone.

search.already_done_text: You've already found what was hidden here.

success.success_text: Among the shells and silt, you find a rare sea snail with a shell patterned like ink in water.

search.fail_text: You sift through the shells but find nothing of interest.

interactables.name: pit wall
interactables.examine_text: The wall is slick but climbable with effort.
